set.body:
Problem
d526-floor/context_human cites only 110-114 s records for a 152-155 s target; the offline probe
(target_scope_probe.py, target-scope-adverse-evidence.json) moves the target to 10000-10003 s and
the validator still accepts the same four Supported proofs. Deterministic hole; no model calls.

Change
A Supported/Contradicted component proof must connect its cited records to the target interval:
either a cited record overlaps the target, or the proof reaches it through cited continuity,
identity or reported-event links, each with its own stated basis. Unbound records keep their
local facts; the attribution becomes Unresolved. No blanket overlap rule: persistence across
cuts and dialogue about earlier events stay legal when cited.

First determine where the guard belongs: tools/connected_assessment_probe.py only, or also
align ClaimAssessmentReceipt (reference-scope and the storyatlas4s sibling seam apply if Scala).

Acceptance
- The target-shift probe becomes a named test that fails on current code.
- Deleting the guard makes that named test fail while its siblings pass (SD1).
- Paired positive control passes: a target reached by cited continuity across a cut.
- Report the re-scored frozen outputs; expect fewer matching resolutions. Gold unchanged.

Evidence: .agent-work/connected-assessment-20261023/{report.md,target-scope-adverse-evidence.json,mote-handoff.txt}; .agent-work/facet-assessment-20261022/report.md
set.title: [evidence-binding S0] Refuse Supported proofs not bound to the target interval
